chapter: Mingus and the call from Hampton
title: Loving the bass despite no formal training
summary: Monk says he was in love with the instrument and with expressing himself, unbothered by his lack of training.

And I loved my instrument. I was just in love with the bass. Nothing else. I was in love with what I was doing, playing this and expressing myself. I had the kind of freedom that you have...I enjoyed it even though I was ignorant to the fact of formal training. I was ignorant to that. But that didn't bother me too much because inside I knew what was happening was the most important thing to me, that I was able to express myself...
